This is an escape-proof facility!!!
column2: 這裡是絕對逃不出去的設施！！！

column1: Who says you can't learn anything from cartoons, eh kitty?
column2: 誰說卡通學不到東西的，是吧小貓咪？

column1: Hey!  No pets!
column2: 欸！不准帶寵物！

column1: You might spook the humans!
column2: 你可能會嚇到人類！

column1: Yeah, good thinking.
column2: 對，好主意。

column1: kennel
column2: 狗籠

column1: A better means of transportation than I would have guessed.
column2: 比我原本想的交通方式好多了。

column1: I think it's a fireplace. Either that or the end of a big vacuum hose.
column2: 我想那是壁爐。不然就是大吸塵管的末端。

column1: I don't think I'm strong enough to move it.
column2: 我看我力氣不夠搬動它。

column1: It's as open as it gets.
column2: 它已經開到最大了。

column1: There's nothing to close.
column2: 沒有東西可以關。

column1: It says, `Hello, my name is.`
column2: 上面寫著`您好，我的名字是`。

column1: Boy, that would be funny.
column2: 老天，那會很好笑。

column1: No, I want to save it for my next sci fi convention.
column2: 不，我要留到下次的科幻大會用。

column1: No, I should leave it blank.\255\003Then I can give it to girls and tell them it's a backstage pass.
column2: 不，我應該留空白。\255\003這樣我就可以拿去給女生，跟她們說這是後台通行證。

column1: He didn't say anything about filling it out.
column2: 他沒說要填寫。

column1: You're ready to go now.
column2: 你現在可以出發了。

column1: I wouldn't want to waste it.
column2: 我不想浪費它。

column1: name tag
column2: 名牌

column1: What the--?
column2: 搞什麼——？

column1: Show some restraint!\255\003What are you, HUMAN?
column2: 節制一點！\255\003你是什麼，人類嗎？

column1: That's for calling me human.
column2: 這是你叫我人類的下場。

column1: Hmpf!
column2: 哼！

column1: This is why I hate working with humans.
column2: 這就是我討厭跟人類共事的原因。

column1: Now, beat it.
column2: 快滾吧。

column1: He looks a lot like my uncle Reggie.
column2: 他長得很像我的雷吉叔叔。

column1: He might get upset^
column2: 他可能會生氣^

column1: I don't need anything right now, thank you.
column2: 我現在什麼都不需要，謝謝。

column1: Bribes won't work.\255\003You're just too darn UGLY.
column2: 賄賂沒用。\255\003你就是醜得太離譜了。

column1: tentacle
column2: 觸手

column1: This one looks like Purple Tentacle, too.
column2: 這隻看起來也像紫色觸手。

column1: I think it's a picture of Purple Tentacle.
column2: 我想那是紫色觸手的畫像。

column1: They'll just throw me back in jail!\255\003I'm never going back there!\255\003I'm reformed!
column2: 他們只會把我丟回牢裡！\255\003我絕對不要再回去！\255\003我已經改過自新了！

column1: It's hung sort of high, I might strain myself.
column2: 它掛得有點高，我可能會扭到。

column1: Is it too late to register for the human show?
column2: 現在報名人類展會不會太晚？

column1: Uh, the guard-guy wants to see you in the kennel.
column2: 呃，那個守衛先生要你去狗籠找他。

column1: Could I register another human for the show?
column2: 我可以再幫一個人類報名嗎？

column1: I'll ruin the show for everybody if you don't let me in.
column2: 你不讓我參加，我就把整場比賽搞砸。

column1: When's the show going to start?
column2: 比賽什麼時候開始？

column1: Boo!
column2: 哇！

column1: For you?\255\003Much, much too late.
column2: 對你來說？\255\003太晚太晚了。

column1: He said to just leave all your stuff here.
column2: 他說把你的東西全都留在這裡就好。

column1: Which guard?  What's his name?
column2: 哪個守衛？他叫什麼名字？

column1: I told you:  The Guard-Guy.
column2: 我說了：守衛先生。

column1: Ken.
column2: 阿肯。

column1: I don't know.  I usually call him, `Mr. Tentacle Guy.`
column2: 我不知道。我平常都叫他`觸手先生`。

column1: Just get your butt in there.  That's his name.
column2: 你給我進去就對了。那就是他的名字。

column1: What a coincidence--that's my name!
column2: 好巧啊——我也叫這個名字！

column1: Really?
column2: 真的嗎？

column1: Of course not!\255\003Now, beat it.
column2: 當然不是！\255\003快滾吧。

column1: Why don't you beat it now?
column2: 你怎麼不現在就滾？

column1: I've got a lot of standing around to do.
column2: 我還有一堆崗要站。

column1: You can't do anything!\255\003You are a HUMAN!\255\003This is a tentacle's world!\255\003Don't you get it?
column2: 你什麼都不能做！\255\003你是人類！\255\003這是觸手的世界！\255\003你還不懂嗎？

column1: Only tentacles can own property,\255\003only tentacles can vote,\255\003and only TENTACLES can register humans in the show!
column2: 只有觸手能擁有財產，\255\003只有觸手能投票，\255\003也只有觸手能幫人類報名比賽！

column1: You'd ruin it for everybody if I did.
column2: 我要是讓你報名，你會把大家的比賽搞砸。

column1: We're still waiting for one more human to fill the last stall.
column2: 我們還在等一個人類來填最後一個位子。

column1: I'll fill it!
column2: 我來填！

column1: With what?\255\003Don't answer that.
column2: 用什麼填？\255\003不用回答。

column1: Please.  Your looks are scary enough.
column2: 拜託。你的長相已經夠嚇人了。

column1: Hi!  I'm La--
column2: 嗨！我是拉——

column1: Woo-ee!\255\003You are one UGLY human!
column2: 哇噻！\255\003你真是個醜人類！

column1: Excuse me?
column2: 你說什麼？

column1: Man, I'm not kidding.\255\003You are just about the HOMELIEST homo sapien I've ever seen!
column2: 老兄，我不是開玩笑的。\255\003你大概是我見過最其貌不揚的智人了！

column1: Are you trying to tell me something?
column2: 你是想暗示我什麼嗎？

column1: Thanks.  You ain't so hot yourself.
column2: 謝了。你自己也沒多好看。

column1: Hold on.  I feel like I'm about to sock you.
column2: 等一下。我覺得我快要揍你了。

column1: Well, I must be on my ugly way.
column2: 好吧，那我這個醜八怪先走了。

column1: Yeah.\255\003You're a real woof.
column2: 對啊。\255\003你真是隻醜狗。

column1: I mean, your hair alone is going to give me nightmares.\255\003Not to mention your teeth, your clothes^\255\003^your one eye that's bigger than the other^
column2: 我是說，光你那頭髮就夠我做惡夢了。\255\003更別提你的牙齒、你的衣服^\255\003^還有你那一大一小的眼睛^

column1: Gee, how much worse could I get?
column2: 唉，我還能再糟到哪裡去？

column1: Not much, unless there were two of you.
column2: 糟不了多少，除非有兩個你。

column1: I never said I was, but sheesh!\255\003Have you taken a look at yourself lately?
column2: 我又沒說我好看，但天啊！\255\003你最近有照過鏡子嗎？

column1: Oh, so you're ugly AND foul-tempered^
column2: 喔，所以你又醜脾氣又壞^

column1: Dang. That feeling always leaves me right when I need it.
column2: 可惡。那股衝動總在我需要的時候消失。

column1: Thank you.  I don't know how much more I could take.
column2: 謝謝。我不知道我還能承受多少。

column1: I guess I'd better just go shoot myself, then.
column2: 那我看我還是去自我了斷好了。

column1: Where I come from, I happen to be quite the babe.
column2: 在我來的地方，我可是個大美人。

column1: What is this?  A beauty contest?
column2: 這是什麼？選美比賽嗎？

column1: I think I'm going to kill you.
column2: 我覺得我要宰了你。

column1: Oh, you don't have to do that!\255\003We have staff here that can do that for you.\255\003The doctor monitoring the human show, in fact, is a specialist in the field.
column2: 喔，你不必自己動手！\255\003我們這裡有員工可以代勞。\255\003事實上，監督人類展的那位醫生就是這方面的專家。

column1: You mean the kennel?\255\003That doesn't say much.\255\003Everyone in there is a human show reject!
column2: 你是說狗籠嗎？\255\003那不代表什麼。\255\003裡面每一個都是人類展的落選者！

column1: Well, I don't know if you could really call a human show a `beauty contest.`\255\003It's more like a `least ugly contest.`
column2: 嗯，我不確定人類展算不算得上`選美比賽`。\255\003比較像是`比誰最不醜大賽`。

column1: Now, now.\255\003You're never going to get into the human show with that attitude.\255\003Not to mention that face.
column2: 好了好了。\255\003你這種態度是進不了人類展的。\255\003更別提你那張臉了。

column1: Human show!?!  Hot dang!  Sign me up!
column2: 人類展？！太好了！幫我報名！

column1: Human show!?!  How degrading!  You should be ashamed!
column2: 人類展？！太侮辱人了！你應該覺得可恥！

column1: Human show, shmuman shmow.  Who needs it?
column2: 人類展、人類爛展，誰稀罕啊？

column1: Well, I gotta go arrange your death now.
column2: 好了，我得去安排你的死期了。

column1: Sorry, humans can't sign themselves up, no matter how ugly they are.\255\003Go ask your owner to sign you up.\255\003Ask them to sign you up for a haircut while they're at it.
column2: 抱歉，人類不能自己報名，再醜也不行。\255\003去叫你的主人幫你報名。\255\003順便叫他們幫你報名剪個頭髮。

column1: Yes, working with humans is degrading, but somebody has to do it.
column2: 沒錯，跟人類共事很掉價，但總得有人做。

column1: The winner gets dinner for two at Club Tentacle.
column2: 優勝者可以獲得觸手俱樂部的雙人晚餐。

column1: Why would I want to go there?
column2: 我幹嘛想去那裡？

column1: Not you.  Your owner!\255\003Oh, forget it.
column2: 不是你。是你的主人！\255\003喔，算了。

column1: You really should get some professional help.
column2: 你真的該找專業人士幫幫忙。

column1: I already have a therapist.
column2: 我已經有心理治療師了。

column1: I was thinking more like a beautician.
column2: 我想的比較是美容師。

column1: Hello. I'm a tentacle.
column2: 你好。我是一隻觸手。

column1: I'd like to enter my insignificant human in the show.
column2: 我想幫我那微不足道的人類報名比賽。

column1: Oh, my.\255\003Yes, yes.  Of course.
column2: 唉呀。\255\003好的好的。當然。

column1: Take these tags, put them on your human, and have them wait on the bench in the lobby.
column2: 拿著這些名牌，掛到你的人類身上，然後讓牠在大廳的長椅上等。

column1: Entrants will be judged in three categories:\255\003Best smile, best hair, and best laugh.
column2: 參賽者將接受三個項目的評分：\255\003最佳笑容、最佳毛髮、最佳笑聲。

column1: Thank you, fellow tentacle.\255\003Unlike humans, you have been very useful.
column2: 謝謝你，觸手同胞。\255\003不像人類，你非常有用。

column1: Oh, uh, thank you.\255\003Believe me, it was my pleasure.
column2: 喔，呃，謝謝。\255\003相信我，這是我的榮幸。

column1: (Now all I need is a human!)
column2: （現在我只差一個人類了！）

column1: Yowza!
column2: 哇噻！

column1: That was one GOOD LOOKIN' tentacle!
column2: 那可真是隻好看的觸手！

column1: When's the show going to start, my inhuman comrade?
column2: 比賽什麼時候開始，我的非人同志？

column1: Just as soon as we get enough humans in the lobby with their tags on.
column2: 等大廳裡掛好名牌的人類夠多就開始。

column1: How'd a hot-looking tentacle babe like you get so boring?
column2: 你這麼辣的觸手妹怎麼會這麼無趣？

column1: So, you're ugly AND boring, eh?
column2: 所以你又醜又無趣，是吧？

column1: It has a dent in it shaped like my skull.\255\003Why did I pick this stupid thing up?
column2: 上面有個我頭骨形狀的凹痕。\255\003我當初幹嘛撿這蠢東西？

column1: No need for a hubcap there, just like most places.
column2: 那裡不需要輪轂蓋，跟大部分地方一樣。

column1: hubcap
column2: 輪轂蓋

column1: There's a hamster in there, I think.\255\003Or, at least, pieces of one.
column2: 我想裡面有隻倉鼠。\255\003至少是牠的一部分。

column1: dust ball
column2: 灰塵球

column1: That's how you empty the vacuum cleaner, I guess.
column2: 我猜那是倒吸塵器的地方。

column1: hatch
column2: 艙蓋

column1: Vacuum up mice?\255\003Maybe later.
column2: 吸老鼠？\255\003也許等一下吧。

column1: I don't do housework.
column2: 我不做家事。

column1: I can't.  It's built-in.
column2: 我沒辦法。它是嵌入式的。

column1: It has a door on the side.
column2: 它側面有一扇門。
